macros.name: delims
macros.doc: The statement \delims puts left and right delimiters around the whole sub-proof, without changing the alignment (the spacing is affected by the delimiters, however).

macros.name: ebproofnewstyle
macros.doc: The statement \ebproofnewstyle defines a new style option with some ⟨name⟩ that sets a given set of ⟨options⟩.

macros.name: ebproofset
macros.doc: The statement \ebproofset is used to set some options.

macros.name: ellipsis
macros.doc: The statement \ellipsis typesets vertical dots, with a label on the right, and a new conclusion.

macros.name: hypo
macros.doc: The statement \hypo pushes a new proof tree consisting only in one conclusion line, with no premiss and no line above, in other words a tree with only a leaf (\hypo stands for hypothesis).

macros.name: infer
macros.doc: The statement \infer builds an inference step by taking some proof trees from the top of the stack, assembling them with a rule joining their conclusions and putting a new conclusion below.

macros.name: overlay
macros.doc: The statement \overlay combines the last two proofs on the stack into a single one, so that their conclusions are placed at the same point.

macros.name: rewrite
macros.doc: The statement \rewrite is used to modify the proof of the stack while preserving its size and alignment.

envs.name: prooftree
envs.doc: The package provides the prooftree environment, in standard and starred variants. This typesets the proof tree described by the ⟨statements⟩, as described in section 3.
